Landing.subline: Parts Tracker checks the shops PCPartPicker doesn't cover, matches every listing to the exact part and keeps the cheapest in-stock price at the top of your build.
Landing.note: Free to use. New accounts may need an admin's approval.

how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps, then it runs on its own.

step1.title: List your parts
step1.body: Add the parts in your build. Each one is identified by its barcode and a clean name, so variants don't get mixed up.

step2.title: We check the shops
step2.body: On a schedule, Parts Tracker visits every shop you follow, matches listings to your parts and records price and stock.

step3.title: Buy at the low
step3.body: Your dashboard shows the cheapest in-stock offer per part, the build total, its history and every drop since your last visit.

band.title: Start tracking your build.
band.body: Bring a parts list. We'll bring the shops.
